title: MicroClazz
description: Instantly compile and load Java classes with in-game commands.
body:
## MicroClass adds in-game commands for compiling and loading java class on fly. ``` /microclazz load ``` - Load a class from a .class or .java file.
*Tip: There are example Java scripts you can try yourself to see how it works!* ``` /microclazz unload ``` - Unload a previously loaded class. ``` /microclazz invoke ``` - Invoke a method from a loaded class. ``` /microclazz list ``` - List all currently loaded classes. There's examples java you can try yourself. ## Script Lifecycle - **`onScriptLoad()`** – Called when a script is successfully loaded - **`onScriptUnLoad()`** – Called when a script is unloaded > These hooks let scripts initialize or clean up resources dynamically.
